label: Complex chronic adverse events following immunization: a systemic critique and reform proposal for vaccine pharmacovigilance.
summary: The COVID-19 pandemic has renewed attention to complex chronic health conditions that challenge conventional biomedical paradigms. Syndromes such as postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome and myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome have gained broader visibility through the lens of Long COVID.
